Definition: from G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G4689; literally, without libation (which usually accompanied a treaty), i.e. (by implication) truceless:--implacable, truce-breaker.
BiblicalUsage: In Paul's picture of the last days, men are without natural affection and trucebreakers, people who will not keep a treaty even when one is offered. The word is built from the libation poured out when a covenant was made, and these men refuse the cup.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a world that will not keep its word has lost the very thing that holds families and nations together.
